subject: science
concept: Observing patterns in the moon's appearance over time (moon phases)
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student tracks a simulated moon's appearance over several virtual nights and records the pattern
exercise.pictorial: Student sequences moon phase pictures in the correct repeating order
exercise.abstract: Student predicts what moon phase comes next in a described sequence

misconception_flags: believes the moon's shape physically changes rather than how much of it is lit and visible

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
